svg.title: Actuary — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as actuary, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A probability curve is clearly separated from its chart axes above a sparse three-column observation table. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, an oval face and round glasses.
